title: Compare plugin output
description: Output contract for interface change-detector plugins. Includes required semantic fields and textual detail. breaking=true is still valid output.

breaking.description: True if the after document introduces one or more breaking changes relative to before.

extra.description: Optional extensions (for example changeCounts). Must not replace or redefine breaking.

examples.raw:
BREAKING: Removed path GET /pets
NON-BREAKING: Added optional query parameter limit on GET /orders
